sourceReviews.review: For ANY topological X and ANY actual family U of opens,the SAME actual Hom cosimplicial/cochain complex of the previously proved free-SHEAF Cech resolution is canonically isomorphic to the original native FULL Cech complex,including all face maps,differentials and signs. For an ACTUAL cover and an injective ABELIAN SHEAF F,ALL positive native FULL Cech homology objects vanish.No affine,Noetherian,desired Cech acyclicity or Cech/native-H comparison premise is input. This does NOT assert injectivity of an O-module underlying abelian sheaf. All17 exact full types,standard axioms,roles and authored bodies read:4 ordinary theorems,13 object constructions,0statement definitions,0proof-term definitions. Local affine Leray comparison for arbitrary coefficients and ordered/full Cech bridge remain OPEN;so do projective Serre-bound existence,proper-duality transpose,original4.1/4.2/main. The failed and unused direct sheaf-coproduct comparison is NOT in this closure;the successful proof uses exact native sheafification ADJUNCTION and presheaf coproducts.
